purpose: Teach: アットホーム/ともなっ/見なし/三四郎/インテリジェント/平年/山川/加護

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが「アットホームな職場が一番」と仰った
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was young, he used to say that a home-like workplace was the best.
lines.style: Soft, remembering voice. Gentle opening. Slow pace, letting each phrase settle. Gaze turned inward, reaching back decades. Warm but tinged with longing.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、苦労をともなって生きて来られたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and Grandpa, when he was young, he lived through so much hardship, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Affirming and warm, but with a gentle redirect. Eyes knowing. Tender without being saccharine. A light touch of question at the end, inviting him back to the present.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが私を「天使と見なしてた」と仰った
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was young, he used to say he saw me as an angel.
lines.style: Voice catches slightly on the word 'angel'. Eyes soften. Vulnerability beneath the remembering. Quiet, almost fragile. Trailing off like he's still holding that belief somewhere.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、夏目漱石の三四郎を愛読されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, when he was young, you loved reading Soseki's Sanshiro, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Playful warmth. A knowing smile in the voice. Gentle teasing — she's caught him in the act of deep nostalgia. Affirming but drawing him gently back to shared ground.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは「インテリジェントな会話」を大事にされた
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was young, he really valued thoughtful conversation.
lines.style: Reverent tone. Speaking of his father's priorities with quiet pride. Measured pace. A hint of wishing those conversations still happened. Dignity in the memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、平年の収穫を喜ばれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, when you were young, you were so grateful for a decent harvest, weren't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm, almost teasing affection. Practical knowledge in her voice — she knows him. Bright but grounded. Gently anchoring him to earth, to simpler things.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが「山川草木の風景に救われる」と仰った
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was young, he used to say he was saved by the beauty of mountains, rivers, grass, and trees.
lines.style: Voice full of quiet wonder. Each image given its own breath. Slow, meditative pacing. Reverent for nature, for his father's sensitivity. A confession and a prayer.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、「神仏のご加護に感謝」と仰ったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, when you were young, you always used to say you were grateful for the protection of gods and Buddha, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm, affirming voice. Gentle closing quality — this feels like the end of something. Tender and knowing. A soft, lingering emphasis on his faith, on what held him up.
